title: Amazing day

title: Nice day on Montserrat mountain
text: We had an excellent guided tour of the Montserrat mountain and its monastery. After having done this tour, we decided to do another one along the Costa Brava with the same company. We are very satisfied. The guide has been very good. I recommend this company.

title: Wonderful day
